description: A piece longer than one Music 3 track, written as sections and joined. Music 3 is practical to about 300 s (stay at or under it); a longer piece is generated section by section, each section trimmed to its length, faded out a little, and crossfaded into the next. 'sections' is a list of {name, caption, lyrics, seconds, audio_duration}: 'caption' is that section's Music 3 prompt, 'lyrics' its tagged lyrics (empty for an instrumental), 'seconds' the length kept, and 'audio_duration' the generation ceiling - 1.5 times 'seconds', per the Music 3 skill, because the ceiling is not a target and a ceiling set at the wanted length cuts the end off and stretches the caption; the engine does no arithmetic, so write both. The loaded model is reused across sections. The sections are generated independently: section-to-section style continuity is NOT guaranteed - key, tempo, instrumentation and mix can all change at a seam, so repeat the same style tags in every caption, keep each section's caption describing the same band, and expect to listen at the joins. 'crossfade_ms' (1500 by default) overlaps the end of one section with the start of the next, which hides a change of sound better than a short fade but cannot hide a change of tempo; 'section_fade_out_ms' (400) rounds each section's trimmed end. A beat-aligned join through analyze_beats is not attempted. The joined piece is peak-normalized to -3 dBFS (Music 3 lands at or over full scale; see 'minimax/music'). Cost grows with the sum of the sections' 'audio_duration'.

sections.name: intro
sections.caption: warm acoustic folk, fingerpicked guitar, soft brushed drums, intimate male vocal, 90 BPM
sections.lyrics:
[verse]
Morning comes in slow across the field
Everything I carried finally healed

sections.name: chorus
sections.caption: warm acoustic folk, fingerpicked guitar, soft brushed drums, intimate male vocal, 90 BPM, a lift into the chorus
sections.lyrics:
[chorus]
Let it rise, let it rise
Gold along the skyline

summary: A piece longer than one Music 3 track, written as sections and crossfaded together.
